article.title_es: Christian Fellowship Seventh Day Adventist: despensa y comidas en Brooklyn
article.title_en: Christian Fellowship Seventh Day Adventist: food pantry in Brooklyn
article.summary_es: Una despensa de alimentos y cocina comunitaria en Brooklyn, en el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad. Tiene horarios distintos para cada servicio.
article.summary_en: A food pantry and soup kitchen in Brooklyn, listed on the City's Food Help NYC map. It has different hours for each service.
how_they_help_es: Cocina comunitaria (comida servida) de lunes a miércoles de 5pm a 6pm.
Despensa de alimentos los miércoles de 10:30am a 12:30pm.
La despensa abre solo el primer, segundo, tercer y cuarto miércoles del mes.
Está en 777 Schenectady Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11203.
Puede llamar al (718) 916-0956 para preguntar antes de ir.
how_they_help_en: Soup kitchen (meals served) Monday to Wednesday, 5pm to 6pm.
The pantry is open only on the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and 4th Wednesday of the month.
Located at 777 Schenectady Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11203.
You can call (718) 916-0956 to ask before visiting.
visit_tips_es: Vaya a la cocina comunitaria entre las 5pm y las 6pm de lunes a miércoles.
Para la despensa, confirme que el miércoles sea el primero, segundo, tercero o cuarto del mes.
Llame al (718) 916-0956 si tiene preguntas; no se indica qué alimentos dan ni si piden requisitos.
visit_tips_en: Go to the soup kitchen between 5pm and 6pm, Monday to Wednesday.
For the pantry, check that the Wednesday is the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, or 4th of the month.
Call (718) 916-0956 with questions; what food is given and any requirements are not listed.

faq_es.a: Una cocina comunitaria de lunes a miércoles de 5pm a 6pm y una despensa de alimentos los miércoles de 10:30am a 12:30pm.
Solo el primer, segundo, tercer y cuarto miércoles del mes, de 10:30am a 12:30pm.

faq_es.q: ¿Qué debo llevar o qué alimentos dan?
faq_es.a: No se indica en la información disponible. Llame al (718) 916-0956 para preguntar antes de ir.

faq_en.q: What services does this place offer?
faq_en.a: A soup kitchen Monday to Wednesday, 5pm to 6pm, and a food pantry on Wednesdays, 10:30am to 12:30pm.
Only on the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and 4th Wednesday of the month, from 10:30am to 12:30pm.

faq_en.q: What should I bring, and what food do they give?
faq_en.a: That is not listed in the available information. Call (718) 916-0956 to ask before you go.
